in_sanskrit.name: Ivanthansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wisdom and Power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ivanthansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ivanthansh is a combination of the names 'Ivan' and 'Thansh'. Ivan is a popular Hindu name meaning 'God'. Thansh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Thanshana', which means 'wisdom'. Thus, Ivanthansh represents the god of wisdom and power.
